final: WITH identifier_hand AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_award AS ma JOIN player AS p ON CAST(ma.player_id AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY = CAST(p.player_id AS TEXT) COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.bats), hand_totals AS (SELECT bats, SUM(record_count) AS hand_total FROM identifier_hand GROUP BY bats), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(hand_total) AS total FROM hand_totals) SELECT h.bats, h.hand_total, 1.0 * h.hand_total / o.total FROM hand_totals AS h JOIN overall_total AS o ON o.total IS NOT NULL
